title: NFL Card Watch Week 6: C.J. Stroud, Caleb Williams & Monday Night Bounties
summary: C.J. Stroud and Caleb Williams bounced back in Week 6. Explore the top NFL cards in Courtyard packs, plus 70k point bounties for tonight's Commanders-49ers drop
body_markdown:
After tonight,[the 2026 NFL regular season](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) will officially be one third of the way over. Wipe your eyes, football fans, we’ve had six glorious weeks of NFL RedZone, and we’ve got another 12 to go!


Before Scott Hanson took over the calls for yesterday’s afternoon matchups, we were treated to a nail-biter in the Jacksonville Jaguars’ home away from home: Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London, England. After starting the season 0-4, the Texans have now won two straight, with yesterday’s victory coming on a last-second Ka’imi Fairbairn field goal.[C.J. Stroud](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=C.J.%20Stroud&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) has got his mojo back,[Marvin Harrison Jr.](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Marvin%20Harrison%20Jr&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) remains an NFL wide receiver, and the rest of the action Sunday was as climactic as each and every football Sunday tends to be.


Here’s who stood out, how you can get their football cards on Courtyard, and the gems you can find in the latest[Monday Night Game Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=limited_drop) ahead of tonight’s matchup between the Washington Commanders and San Francisco 49ers at Levi’s Stadium.


## **Sunday's Week 6 Standouts and Their Cards on Courtyard**


### [C.J. Stroud](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=C.J.%20Stroud&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **:**


The Texans QB finished the transatlantic matchup with 312 yards, three touchdowns, and a pick. Not bad for a former #2 overall pick that many seem to have written off.[Jaylin Noel](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jaylin%20Noel&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) caught four passes for 107 yards and a score, his first time hitting the century mark, as Stroud proved that he doesn’t need Nico Collins to do it all. For those looking to pounce while he attempts to right the Texans’ ship, there are two big Stroud cards found in[Courtyard’s football packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) : a 2023 Panini Prizm Blue Shimmer #339 (PSA 9), which has a fair market value of $3,864, and a 2023 Panini Prizm Fireworks Gold Prizm #F10 (PSA 10) with a FMV of $3,100.


### [Caleb Williams](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Caleb%20Williams&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **:**


Returning from a[much-meme’d](https://sports.yahoo.com/nfl/article/the-best-of-the-actually-funny-caleb-williams-injury-memes-230354732.html) three-week absence, Iceman did his best to dispel the Madden Curse rumors—but the Falcons didn’t make it easy, eating away at a 31-7 lead in the 4th quarter. Coleston Loveland sure appreciated having Williams back, completing 30 of his 36 passes (!) for 305 yards and a touchdown as the Bears hung on to get the W, improving to 4-2 on the season. The best Caleb Williams card in a Courtyard Football Pack is a 2024 Panini Prizm Prizmania #1 rookie card (PSA 10) with a whopping FMV of $6,565. Don’t sleep on the two 2024 Panini Donruss Downtown! #21 rookie cards (PSA 10), each of which carries a FMV of $2,976.


### [Trevor Lawrence](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Trevor%20Lawrence&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **:**


The golden-haired Jags QB threw for 306 yards and four touchdowns on 24-of-41 passing—and Jacksonville still lost. The Jags are now 4-2, albeit *this* close to being 5-1 with a massive lead in the AFC South. For those who believe in both Lawrence and the rest of this Jags offense, the top Lawrence in Courtyard’s Football Packs is a 2021 Panini Select Color Wheel #CW16 Gold Prizm rookie card (PSA 10) with a FMV of $4,279.


### [Luther Burden III](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Luther%20Burden%20III&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **:**


The 22-year-old Chicago Bears wide receiver benefited from Caleb Williams’ big day (and an atrocious Atlanta Falcons defense). Burden III hauled in 8 receptions (on 8 targets) for 95 yards in arguably his best performance of the season thus far. The Bears are relying on Burden and[Rome Odunze](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Rome%20Odunze&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) to lead the WR room, and thus far, they’ve done an admirable job. Looking to chase Burden before the 4-2 Bears meet the 4-2 Patriots on Thursday Night Football? There’s a PSA 10 Silver Prizm #331 rookie card available in packs that has a FMV of $218. Will that number go up as the season goes on?


### [Jonathan Taylor](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jonathan%20Taylor&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **:**


We can’t say much about Taylor that hasn’t already been said. The three-time Pro Bowler has a First-team All-Pro selection under his belt, as well as a rushing title (2021)...and still, the Colts lost to the previously winless Tennessee Titans, dropping to 2-4 on the season. Taylor had 94 yards and a touchdown on 21 carries, and added another 57 yards through the air, but[Daniel Jones](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Daniel%20Jones&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) took six sacks and tossed two picks in the Colts' defeat. Even still, the star running back is a fan favorite, and football fans can get his 2020 Panini Donruss Optic Autograph Holo rookie card #167 (PSA 10) in Courtyard’s Football Packs.


### [Travis Hunter](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Travis%20Hunter&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) **:**


A defensive star has made Courtyard’s NFL Card Watch. I repeat, *a defensive star has made Courtyard’s NFL Card Watch* ! The two-way player caught all four of his targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in the latest London game, and added an interception for good measure. There are some absolute Travis Hunter nukes in Courtyard’s football packs, headlined by a 2025 Absolute Kaboom Vertical Gold #36 rookie card (BGS 9.5) with a FMV of $8,430. The 2025 Donruss Optic Downtown Black Pandora #13 rookie card(BGS 9.5) with a FMV of $2,916 isn’t too shabby either.


[Drake Maye](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Drake%20Maye&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) also gets an honorable mention. After making last week’s[Courtyard NFL card watch](https://courtyard.io/blog/post/blog-post-nfl-week-5-standouts-rookie-cards-values?d565656f_page=2) list, Maye hung 235 yards and three TDs on the New York Jets. After a rough start to the year, it appears his mental might not be so broken after all…and while the jury is still far from settled on[JJ McCarthy](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=JJ%20McCarthy&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , he looked decent at the end of the New York Giants vs. New Orleans Saints game.

Launching Monday morning and disappearing after just 24 hours, this week’s pack focuses on Washington’s trip to Levi’s Stadium in the Bay Area. The 49ers are a perfect 5-0, and[Brock Purdy](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Brock%20Purdy&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) has 1,196 passing yards and 13 touchdowns through five games, partially powered by the never-ending career of future Hall of Famer[Mike Evans](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Mike%20Evans&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) and the hot start of[Christian McCaffrey](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Christian%20McCaffrey&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) .


Given their success, it’s no surprise that football fans on Courtyard have been searching for these stars.
